subject: reasoning
question:
Two positions of a dice are given below. What will come on the face opposite to the face containing '2' on it? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f876878a49244a709242fdf282c709e020272c50a9754dcbc5f09181989f2c0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a8f6d4588429d654bdae6a923590561e02aa150f33c52d07d693bb8c5a59699.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of '2', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f28c326a1c1306f632de233ddb84897c3b8af9712ad4af7ac6150505fc17fbe3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbf8bfc6966fb782d6a3b32f6ef9977d461de2619834bc20991988e56ba10001.png] 

From both dices, 4 is common so we will rotate in clockwise direction start from 4.

So, '3' will be the opposite face of '2'.

Hence, the correct answer is "3".
